description: This file contains the implementation of a concurrent, segmented LRU cache with a TU-Q eviction policy. It defines the internal cache data structures, including the concurrent dictionaries and queues for hot, warm, and cold segments, as well as methods for adding, retrieving, and evicting items, along with telemetry for cache metrics.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruCache
classes.description: A thread-safe cache implementing a segmented LRU eviction policy with hot, warm, and cold segments, supporting concurrent access and eviction.

classes.name: LruItem
classes.description: Represents an individual cache item with key, value, and access metadata, supporting sequence locking for thread safety.

classes.name: TelemetryPolicy
classes.description: Maintains cache hit/miss/eviction statistics and provides metrics reporting.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the cache.

methods.name: Capacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the cache.

methods.name: Metrics
methods.description: Provides cache metrics, including hit ratio, total accesses, hits, misses, evictions, and updates.

methods.name: HotCount
methods.description: Returns the number of hot items.

methods.name: WarmCount
methods.description: Returns the number of warm items.

methods.name: ColdCount
methods.description: Returns the number of cold items.

methods.name: Keys
methods.description: Returns a collection of all keys in the cache.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the specified key, throwing if not found.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the value for the specified key, returning true if successful.

methods.name: TryAdd
methods.description: Attempts to add a new key-value pair to the cache.

methods.name: GetOrAdd
methods.description: Gets the value for a key, or creates and adds it if missing, with concurrency support.

methods.name: TryRemove
methods.description: Attempts to remove a key and its value from the cache, based on a predicate.

methods.name: TryRemove
methods.description: Attempts to remove a key-value pair from the cache.

methods.name: TryRemove
methods.description: Attempts to remove a key and return the removed value.

methods.name: TryUpdate
methods.description: Updates the value for a key if it exists.

methods.name: AddOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds or updates a key-value pair in the cache.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the cache, removing all items.

methods.name: Trim
methods.description: Removes a specified number of least recently used items.
